topic: A person learns their childhood best friend doesn't remember them
text: I always thought some memories were forever, like the ones I have of us playing in the backyard, the secret hideouts, and the silly jokes that only made sense to us. It feels strange to realize that those moments, so vivid in my mind, are just empty spaces for my friend. I wonder, where did those pieces of our childhood go? It’s like trying to hold onto water; the harder I try, the more I feel it slip away. Maybe I’ll share some old photos, see if that helps reconnect the dots. Maybe, just maybe, we can rebuild the bridge between the past and now, one memory at a time.
